# qrwty: rules for coding agents

This is a Jeeves template project. Every element of the design is an instantiated template that
already builds, starts, and passes its template tests. Your job is to implement features inside
the extension points the templates give you, not to change the templates.

## Elements

| ID | Name | Template | Directory | Notes and guide |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `qrwty` | qrwty API | `http-service@0.1.0` | `services/qrwty/` | [notes](jeeves/elements/qrwty.md) |
| `qrwty-db` | qrwty DB | `postgres@0.1.0` | `databases/qrwty-db/` | [notes](jeeves/elements/qrwty-db.md) |
| `qrwty-web` | qrwty web | `web-app@0.1.0` | `frontends/qrwty-web/` | [notes](jeeves/elements/qrwty-web.md) |

Each element's notes file holds what to build (the implementation notes from the design), the
generated standard behavior it must not reimplement, and the template's agent guide (where code
goes and what not to touch). Read it before changing the element.

## Ownership

- **Generated-owned files** are listed with their hashes in `jeeves/lock.json`. Never edit
  them. For this project that includes `docker-compose.yml`, `jeeves/`, `AGENTS.md`, every `*.generated.ts`, every `src/clients/*.openapi.ts`, `services/qrwty/src/generated/**`, `services/qrwty/resource-migrations/**`, `tests/generated/qrwty/**`, `tests/acceptance/qrwty/**`, `contracts/qrwty.openapi.yaml`.
- **`vendor/jeeves/`** holds the template runtimes. Never edit or replace them.
- **Structured resource services are generated-owned:** `qrwty` (contract `contracts/qrwty.openapi.yaml`, generated routes and resource descriptors, `services/qrwty/resource-migrations/`, `tests/generated/qrwty/`, `tests/acceptance/qrwty/`). Do **not** edit the contract, generated routes, resource migrations, generated tests, or fixed acceptance tests. Implement only the declared extension in `services/qrwty/src/features/<extension-id>/`; each extension task names its own directory and operation.
- **Fixed project acceptance** under `tests/acceptance/` (`qrwty/core`, `qrwty/qr-image`, `qrwty/redirect`, `qrwty/activity`, `qrwty/restart`, `qrwty/browser`, `qrwty/artwork`, `qrwty/studio-browser`, `qrwty/owner-analytics`, `qrwty/analytics-browser`) is generated-owned and protected. Agents may add supplemental tests elsewhere, but cannot redefine expected behavior.
- **Everything else is project-owned**: feature code, supplemental tests, `package.json`
  files, Dockerfiles, and any API contract for an element that has no structured resource model. Change it freely, within the element you were asked to work on.
- Stay inside the element's directory, plus the contracts that element owns. If the task needs a
  change elsewhere, stop and say so.

## Checks

Jeeves runs these after every task; run them yourself before you finish:

```sh
pnpm install
pnpm typecheck
pnpm test
docker compose up --build --wait
```

The template test packs run against the composed project and must stay green. Add supplemental
tests for what you build next to the element (`tests/`), or in `tests/e2e/` for flows across
elements.

## Dependencies

Pin exact versions. Don't add a dependency that duplicates what a template runtime already does.
